## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `27e976d737af1e41d407248b4a7cbe37d3328a4e`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #21187 body and all four comments (ruling record 5934170950, claim 5934212807, os-dev-report 5934679331 and 5934891734); PR #21192 body, file list and the net diff against `main`; the check-runs on the head. Readings taken by `gh api` and `git show` at the fetched refs only. The GitHub diff is byte-identical (index lines aside) to `git diff` from the merge base `2c1cef3345738b5f2486eed5b0608687dba36f11` to the head: 5 files, +11 / −11, all under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`. Head repo = base repo (not a fork). Draft, `Clause-②: no`, labels `documentation, size/s, skip-changeset`, auto-merge not armed.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set and public surface: the diff touches no package, no export, no schema, no script, no workflow; it implies no accept-set change and no public-surface change. The only surface that moves is governed PM rule text (Tier S, `.claude/**`). Each changed sentence, judged against ruling A as quoted on the card (「我已经同意了，不需要严格的规则」, answering 「changeset 散文由席位在 ACCEPT 自核」) and the director's record 5934170950 with forks 1 / 2 / 3 settled by 「同意，你负责派发。」:

1. `contract-review.md` face list — 「复核面 = 契约三面:`Clause-②: yes` 申报、已发布 schema(`packages/spec/src/**` 非测试)、governed 规则文本(统一定义见 SKILL.md);`.changeset`/CHANGELOG、`content/docs/**`、`apps/docs/**` 散文面 ⛔ 不在其列:派发席按本席档在 ACCEPT 逐句对照 diff 核,ACCEPT 点名所核句。」 — RIGHT. Exactly the three faces of fork 1 (declaration, published schema non-test, governed rule text); exactly the three prose faces moved out; dispatching seat, own tier, sentence-by-sentence against the diff, ACCEPT names the sentences. Nothing wider, nothing narrower. 「governed 规则文本(统一定义见 SKILL.md)」 resolves at head to SKILL.md line 184 「governed 面统一定义:`docs/adr/**` + `.claude/**`(全量)+ `skills/**` + `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`」 and line 204 「Tier S = `.claude/**` 全树」, so 「`.claude/**` included, Tier S as today」 holds without restating it.
2. `contract-review.md` 「五面皆不碰」 → 「三面皆不碰 ⇒ CI 加席位自读 ⛔ 不起第二个 agent;谁跑 = 派发席,达档者席内审。」 — RIGHT. The count follows the face list; the no-second-agent rule and the in-seat-at-tier allowance are unchanged.
3. `contract-review.md` trigger — 「欠不欠按面判 ⛔ 不按车道:diff 或认领申报碰下列任一面即欠达档复核,交付后当轮完成。」 — RIGHT and necessary: the first face is a claim-comment declaration, not a diff path; without 「或认领申报」 the trigger could never fire for it. Not wider than the ruling: the declaration leg is already how `landing-operations.md` 「声明肢」 reads it.
4. `landing-operations.md` 「交付后复核按面欠 ⛔ 不按车道(三面见 `references/contract-review.md`);双肢命中即 spec 车道。」 — RIGHT. Pointer count only; the two-leg spec-lane rule is untouched.
5. `execution-duties.md` 「契约三面自审资格按车道:spec/skills 席达档席内审;未达档 ⛔ 不自审,起隔离达档子代理。」 — RIGHT. Eligibility is renamed to the faces it now governs; who may review in-seat and the isolated-subagent fallback are unchanged. 「spec 与 skills」 → 「spec/skills」 is spelling only (118 bytes against the 120-byte cap).
6. `lanes/ui.md` 「契约三面复核本席适用:按面欠达档记录落 PR 或卡,散文面归 ACCEPT,见 `../contract-review.md`。」 — RIGHT. The added clause 「散文面归 ACCEPT」 is fork 1's third bullet, not an extension. Dropped 「归属与资格」 and one 「复核」 are qualifiers on a pointer whose target heading is itself 「复核归属与资格(按面)」; no operative loss.
7. `review-checklist.md` new line — 「changeset/CHANGELOG、`content/docs/**`、`apps/docs/**`:逐句核 diff,ACCEPT 点名所核句,⛔ 不起子代理。」 — RIGHT. `execution-duties.md` 〈复核〉 line 「逐项判据展开在 `references/review-checklist.md`,每份报告对着它过」 makes this checklist the ACCEPT's path, so the ruling's ACCEPT duty belongs here. Same content as sentence 1's tail; 「不起子代理」 and 「不起第二个 agent」 are one rule.
8. `review-checklist.md` compression (the payment for 7) — 「dev 本地并集钉 head:所抄 `git rev-parse --short HEAD` 不符 PR `head.sha` 或没抄 ⇒ 双向都不入账。」 replacing two lines — RIGHT, no operative loss on the seat side: the seat's rule (compare to `head.sha`; mismatch or missing ⇒ neither direction counted) survives whole, and 「按没有读数处理」 and 「双向都不入账」 are the same outcome. The dropped words (run after the final commit; quote the sha in both the report and the body) are the dev's obligation and stand at head in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` lines 159–160: 「并集在最终 commit 之后跑,并从那次运行引用 `git rev-parse --short HEAD`。」 and 「报告的 `tests` 字段和 PR 正文两处都要引」. This payment was forced: `review-checklist.md` stands at 77 / 77 (`CEILINGS`, headroom 0).
9. `contract-review.md` independence-pair line — 「独立性对:`Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` 取值同见 `--template`;子代理记采纳它的席位。」 — WIDER THAN THE RULING, declared, loss-free. It is not a face-list sentence; the PR body and both reports present it as the ratchet's price for the face list's extra line, but the `CEILINGS` row for `contract-review.md` is 60 against 40 lines at head (headroom 20), so no payment was owed there. The rule itself is intact: the full `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template` is spelled ten lines above on the `Served-tier:` line, and `--template` is distinct from `--brief-template`. A compression the ratchet header calls 「always legitimate and encouraged」, inside a file the PR already owns; not a reason to fail, recorded so the seat does not read 「paid」 as 「required」.

The two lines ruled unchanged (fork 2) are byte-unchanged: `execution-duties.md` 「改到已有 `.changeset/*.md` 的 PR ⛔ 不打 `skip-changeset`;确认取同 head 达档 PASS 或维护者原话。」 and `landing-operations.md` 「DELIBERATE CORRECTION 红(`check-empty-changeset`):同 head 达档复核 PASS 记录即确认,⛔ 不等维护者。」 each grep exactly once at base and at head with identical md5 of the matching line.

Residue: a `git grep` of the head tree over `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` for 「五面|五处|四面|按面欠|复核面」 hits only the three rewritten anchors plus one unrelated count in `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` (「实测五处、三个包、两张卡」, a retirement story, not the rule). No remaining sentence ties changeset or docs prose to an at-tier record. No added line cites an issue number; no model identifier in the five files, the PR title or the body.

Line and byte readings at head, taken with `git show`: 40 / 60, 101 / 101, 183 / 183, 38 / 38, 77 / 77 lines; the longest added line is 119 bytes against `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`. These are corroboration only; the gate verdict is `Lint & Repo Gates`, below.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is correct: the diff publishes nothing from any released package (`.claude/**` only; zero `.changeset/*.md` in the diff; no `packages/**` path). `Clause-②: no` is declared on the claim (5934212807) and on the PR body's first lines, and matches the diff — no published export, schema or accept set moves. The PR's 「Deliberately unchanged」 and 「Line budget」 sections match the trees byte for byte and count for count.

Clause-②: no

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: empty in both os-dev-reports — nothing to answer. The dev's declared deviations, each answered:

- Round 0, `contract-review.md` line payment (sentence 9 above): accepted as a declared, loss-free edit; its stated reason is wrong (headroom 20, not 0), noted for the seat; not escalated.
- Round 0, `lanes/ui.md` 「散文面归 ACCEPT」 clause: inside fork 1; right.
- Round 0, 「spec 与 skills」 → 「spec/skills」: spelling for the 120-byte cap; right.
- Round 0, PR body paraphrases the seat's proposal because it carries a model-name token: right — AGENTS.md forbids a model identifier in a PR body, the verbatim-quotation exemption covers only maintainer rulings, and both maintainer rulings are quoted verbatim.
- Round 0, model-free commit trailer pair and session-URL footer: right; the body carries exactly one footer in the PR-body form.
- Round 0, mechanism re-measured on base `2c1cef334`: consistent with this review's own grep of the head tree.
- Round 1, CONFLICT — the dev did not PATCH the PR body and handed `pr_body_replacement` to the seat: resolved — the body read for this review already is the replacement (sentences 7 and 8 present, 「All five files」, 18 gate rows, `review-checklist.md` budget row), one footer. No action.
- Round 1, new-line spelling 「⛔ 不起子代理」: same rule as 「不起第二个 agent」; right.
- Round 1, `review-checklist.md` compression: answered in ① item 8 — forced by headroom 0, seat-side rule intact, dev-side words carried by `os-dev.md`.

`out_of_scope_findings`: the round-0 note that the ACCEPT path did not list the prose sentences is resolved by sentence 7. The remaining note — the card's rationale cites a changeset claim re-read that is objectui's (`changeset-presence.yml`), with no counterpart in this tree — is correctly noted in the PR's acceptance notes and not filed: it is neither a reproducible defect, a contract violation nor an authoring trap (Prime Directive #10), and the ruling's reversibility reasoning (a pending changeset stays editable until the Version Packages PR merges) holds on objectstack without that facility. Not escalated.

Check-runs on the head at 2026-10-01T15:51Z: `Lint & Repo Gates` still `in_progress` — it carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` and `check:pm-governed-prose`, so the gate verdict on the five files is not yet in; the seat re-reads before landing. Completed `success`: `TypeScript Type Check` (and its four legs), `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Check PR Size`, `Auto Label`, the four claim/branch guards, `filter`. `skipped` by the paths filter for a `.claude/**`-only diff, not failures: `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, the Test Core and Dogfood shards, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, and `Check Changeset` (the `skip-changeset` label). No check-run has failed. This verdict is on the diff; it does not stand in for the in-progress gate.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-21187-prose-review-at-accept`
Reviewed-by: `session_016tKoy8NJa35Yih1FdzrVmn`

**VERDICT: PASS**

> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）
